{{Quote|You are to go alone to the area in the Zi-Kree sector known as the Crimson Corridor, where a former member of Black Sun is being kept in a safe house. He is to receive the council's protection in return for information regarding a recent shake-up in the higher echelons of that criminal organization. Your job is to bring him back to the Temple alive.|[[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], to [[Darsha Assant]]|<ref name="DMSH" />}}
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Darsha Assant]] undertook a '''mission''' in the [[Crimson Corridor]], a district in the [[Third Quadrant]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Zi-Kree Sector]] to extract a [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] defector known as [[Oolth]]. The latter was the sole survivor of the recent [[Mission to Ralltiir|massacre]] of the Black Sun leadership by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]]. Darsha Assant visited the Crimson Corridor and successfully found Oolth. However, they were later attacked by members of the [[Raptors (gang)|Raptor]] who attempted to steal Assant's [[Skyhopper/Legends|skyhopper]], forcing the Jedi to attack the gangsters. During the skirmish, the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Nig]] lost his hand, cut off by the Padawan's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Darsha Assant and Oolth finally escaped by ascending up a building. They were about to leave the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]] when they were assailed by [[Hawk-bat/Legends|hawk-bats]]. The creatures harmed Oolth's eye who lot his grip and fell into the abyss of the planet.<ref name="DMSH" />
